Container.Name: aoostar-display
Container.Overview:
High-performance, lightweight Rust daemon for driving the front LCD panel (960x376) on the AOOSTAR WTR Max NAS and GEM12+ PRO.
Features: - Replaces heavy Python-based software with a fast, safe, and minimal Alpine Linux Rust container - Real-time CPU, RAM, storage, 10GbE network throughput, and temperature panels - Docker bridge networking support with accurate host network monitoring - Screen Power Management: sleep schedule (night mode) and drive spindown sleep triggers - Differential frame caching to minimize USB bus overhead - Automatic LCD backlight power-off on container shutdown - Configurable panels, fonts, and operational parameters in /config/settings.json
Container.Description: High-performance Rust LCD driver and system monitor for AOOSTAR WTR Max NAS.

Config.Name: Appdata Config Directory
Config.Description: Persistent configuration directory for settings.json, monitor.json, custom panels, and sensor mapping.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port for display configuration and management (future Web UI).

Config.Name: Unraid State Directory
Config.Description: Read-only access to Unraid system state (disks.ini and var.ini) for native array drive temperatures, capacity, spindown detection, and host IP.

Config.Name: Host Network Statistics
Config.Description: Host network statistics for accurate physical 10GbE throughput monitoring while running on Docker bridge network.

Config.Name: Serial Device Path
Config.Description: Serial device path for the front LCD display UART (e.g. /dev/ttyACM0).

Config.Name: Serial Device Passthrough
Config.Description: Passthrough for the LCD USB UART device.

Config.Name: Panel Rotation Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Number of seconds each panel is displayed before rotating to the next panel.

Config.Name: Primary Network Interface
Config.Description: Network interface to display (e.g. auto, br0, bond0, eth0, eth1).

Config.Name: Temperature Unit
Config.Description: Temperature display unit: C for Celsius, F for Fahrenheit.

Config.Name: Enable Sleep Schedule
Config.Description: Enable automatic display blanking during specified sleep hours (e.g. night mode).

Config.Name: Sleep Schedule Start Time
Config.Description: Time to turn off display backlight (24-hour format HH:MM, e.g. 23:00).

Config.Name: Sleep Schedule End Time
Config.Description: Time to wake up display backlight (24-hour format HH:MM, e.g. 07:00).

Config.Name: Sleep on All Disks Standby
Config.Description: Automatically turn off display backlight when all array drives are spun down / in standby.

Config.Name: Standby Sleep Delay (seconds)
Config.Description: Delay in seconds after all array disks enter standby before turning off the display (default: 300 = 5 minutes).

Config.Name: Host Timezone File
Config.Description: Pass host localtime into container for automatic clock synchronization.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Set container timezone to match host for accurate clock display (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Australia/Sydney). Leave as UTC if mounting /var/local/emhttp or /etc/localtime for auto-detection.

Config.Name: Sensor Refresh Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Interval in seconds for refreshing CPU, memory, and network metrics.

Config.Name: Disk Refresh Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Interval in seconds for refreshing disk metrics.

Config.Name: Enable SMART Temperature
Config.Description: Enable smartctl disk temperature retrieval (requires privileged container).

Config.Name: Turn Off Display on Stop
Config.Description: Automatically switch off LCD backlight when container stops.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity (info, debug, warn, error).
